name: Student Program Under AcSIR
benefit: - **Advanced Research Opportunities:** The program provides opportunities for conducting high-quality, interdisciplinary research in various fields of Himalayan Geo-science.  - **Leadership Development:** The scheme aims to develop leaders in the field of Himalayan Geo-science through the PhD program.  - **Career Advancement:** Successful completion of the PhD program leads to a postgraduate degre
_eligibility_text:
- The applicant must have a postgraduate degree (M.Sc./M.Tech.) in any discipline of Earth Sciences.
- The applicant must hold a valid national-level fellowship such as:

1. NET-JRF (UGC/CSIR).
1. INSPIRE Fellowship.
1. Any other equivalent national fellowship.
